column1: # C# NepaliDateRange day helpers (NR24-NR27). Every list is in date order; none is an
# empty result and ERR is a rejected argument (interval below 1). C# also advances one
# day after the last item and throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException at 2199-12-30. The D-16
# rows hold the port's value: every date up to and including 2199-12-30.
